gate.title: Sign in to start collecting
gate.lead: Curio browses pixiv and X as you — the same way your browser does. Sign in to at least one before the first run.
gate.foot: Your login stays on this computer. Curio never sees your password.

source.browserModeLead: In the Curio desktop app, {signIn} opens {site}'s own login page and you're done. A browser tab can't do that — it isn't allowed to see another site's login.
source.pasteToggleShow: developer: paste a session cookie instead
source.pixivHint: pixiv.net tab → DevTools → Application → Cookies → PHPSESSID
source.xHint: x.com tab → DevTools → Application → Cookies → auth_token and ct0
